text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While doing warm-up exercises before 
training...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*... My legs feel kind of heavy 
today...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Still, maybe overcoming situations like 
this is what makes a truly splendid 
Umamusume..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...It's heavy... but I'll do my best... It 
really is heavy, though... but I'll still 
do my best...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser might still be carrying 
fatigue from the race. I should probably 
reconsider her upcoming race schedule.
